title: Eagles OC Sean Mannion: Tush push has been effective for us, we'll continue to "lean into" it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eagles OC Sean Mannion: Tush push has been effective for us, we'll continue to "lean into" it
sources.description: The Eagles changed a lot about their offense this offseason, but offensive coordinator Sean Mannion will be holding onto something from previous regimes.
